newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey goes ahead with public cash pool system.
newsitem.headline: Turkey goes ahead with public cash pool system.

text.p: The Turkish government published a regulation to introduce a system to pool public revenues for better control of state funds, a government official said on Friday.
But he did not say when the regulation would take effect.

He said under the new regulation, state economic enterprises and state-owned banks would close their own time accounts at maturity and transfer their cash to two separate pools -- foreign currency and Turkish lira.
They will not be allowed to draw cash from the pool accounts, open new savings accounts of their own or make repurchase agreements on the bond market.
The pool accounts are expected to be held at state banks.
